[[File:Michael Mikaelian 1996 Worlds.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Michael Mikaelian at the 1996 World Championship. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Michael Mikaelian''' of Brooklyn, New York, won the [[1996 GenCon Open]] and finished 29th at the [[1996 Decipher World Championship]]. He wrote the special report [[Star Wars World Championships (InQuest)]] in ''[[InQuest]]'' #22.<ref name="inquest">Michael Mikaelian, "Star Wars World Championships", ''InQuest'' #22 (February 1997), p. 14. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/inquest-magazine-issue-22 InQuest Magazine Issue 22], Internet Archive.</ref> InQuest #20 printed his Killer Decks II [[Michael Mikaelian Yavin 4 Counterstrike|Yavin 4 Counterstrike]] deck.<ref name="inquest20">Michael Mikaelian, "Killer Decks II", ''InQuest'' #20 (December 1996), pp. 38–39. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/inquest-20 InQuest #20], Internet Archive.</ref> He co-wrote [[Mirror, Mirror (InQuest)|Mirror, Mirror]] in InQuest #39 and [[Sith Element]] in InQuest #43.<ref name="wook-39">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/InQuest_39 InQuest 39], Wookieepedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20251112204442/https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/InQuest_39 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="tfn-iq">[https://www.theforce.net/rpg/magazines/mags-inquestgamer.asp Unofficial Mag Articles – Inquest Gamer], TheForce.Net. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190811165154/http://www.theforce.net/rpg/magazines/mags-inquestgamer.asp Internet Archive]</ref>

He posted on Decipher's [[swccg-discussion]] list in 1998.<ref name="list-55378">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/55378.html? swccg-discussion message #55378], [[Michael Mikaelian]] (1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000108181353/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/55378.html? Internet Archive]</ref>
